subject: integration conflict: apps/web/playwright.config.ts
body:
Rebase onto claude/naadi-shared conflicted in:
- apps/web/playwright.config.ts

Recent integration commits touching them:
fix(web): assistant reply and confirm tile use the violet tokens; e2e: fonts loaded before going offline, budget server keeps its cron scheduler
test(e2e): keep Playwright's DEBUG out of the API process (Aegra parses DEBUG as a boolean)
test(e2e): agent diagnostics against the real Aegra host (webServer runs migrate_all + host; a second server with the LLM budget at zero), per-origin auth state; fire the system ping on first boot
feat(web): pen-surface registration (shell/chrome.tsx), --shell-top/--shell-bottom, per-run e2e users, owner-only-boolean live admin check
feat(web): Supabase sign-in (magic link + Google, PKCE), callback, protected app shell, Today, Account
feat(db): Alembic migrations 0001 core schema + RLS, 0002 storage buckets/policies; migrate at startup
test(e2e): one retry in CI for browser crashes on shared runners
wip(m0): checkpoint segment 01 progress (e2e suite, playwright config, UI updates)

My branch is unchanged (rebase aborted).
